title: Inspector of Posts (IP)
description: Supervises all sub-offices and branch post offices in a sub-division; inspects accounts, audits mail delivery, and conducts fraud inquiries.
activities: Carrying out technical audits of Branch Post Offices (BOs) and checking mail routes
Marketing Postal Life Insurance (PLI) and setting up rural citizen service camps
Verifying delivery beat efficiency and investigating missing parcel/money order cases

title: Branch Postmaster (BPM) / Gramin Dak Sevak
description: Manages a rural Branch Post Office using digital DARPAN devices; handles mail conveyance, IPPB micro-banking, and welfare disbursements.
activities: Disbursing DBT, MGNREGA wages, and social pensions using AePS on DARPAN handheld units
Accepting deposits, opening Sukanya Samriddhi accounts, and executing speed post booking
Supervising last-mile mail delivery and tracking parcels to village households

title: Principal Accountant General (PAG / AG)
ministry_department: Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG)
description: Heads an Audit or Accounts & Entitlement (A&E) office; directs performance/financial audits of ministries, and presents reports to Legislature.
activities: Directing performance audits of state/union government expenditure and public sector units
Compiling the Annual Finance Accounts and Appropriation Accounts of the State Government
Approving draft audit paragraphs for incorporation into the statutory CAG Audit Report

title: Senior Audit Officer (SAO)
ministry_department: Office of the CAG of India
description: Leads audit inspection teams visiting government departments, defense establishments, or PSUs; drafts inspection reports and audit memos.
activities: Scrutinizing voucher-level transactions, contract awards, and GFR deviations in field offices
Drafting specialized Audit Memos, Half-Margins, and Initial Draft Paragraphs (IDPs)
Conducting electronic audits using the One IAAD One System (OIOS) platform

title: Assistant Audit Officer (AAO)
ministry_department: Office of the CAG of India
description: Executes detailed vouching, ledger verification, data analytics on PFMS transactions, and drafts preliminary audit observations.
activities: Extracting and analyzing transactional data from state IFMS and Union PFMS platforms
Evaluating procurement files for compliance with CVC guidelines and GFR stipulations
Documenting factual audit matrices supporting waste, fraud, and system leakages

title: Director General, Geological Survey of India (GSI)
ministry_department: Geological Survey of India / Ministry of Mines
description: Directs baseline geoscience mapping, mineral resource assessments (Lithium, REE, Strategic Minerals), and geophysical hazard mitigation.
activities: Formulating annual national mineral exploration programs and baseline geological mapping
Advising the Union Government on critical mineral reserves and offshore exploration policies
Directing national landslide susceptibility mapping and seismotectonic research

domain: Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act

title: Scientist 'E' / Geologist (GSI)
description: Leads field exploration parties; conducts drilling supervision, geochemical sampling, core-logging, and resource modeling for mining auctions.
activities: Conducting geological mapping (1:12,500/1:5,000 scale) in identified mineralized belts
Logging diamond core-drilling samples and preparing 3D ore-body models on GIS platforms
Submitting G2/G3 mineral block assessment reports compliant with auction standards

title: Scientist 'F' / Meteorologist (IMD)
description: Directs numerical weather prediction models, Doppler radar tracking, and issues national cyclone/monsoon/heatwave warnings.
activities: Running high-resolution numerical weather prediction (NWP) models on supercomputing clusters
Analyzing Doppler Weather Radar (DWR) data and satellite streams to track tropical cyclones
Issuing multi-hazard color-coded warnings to National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)

title: Director General of Health Services (DGHS)
ministry_department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Principal technical adviser to the Union Government on all medical and public health matters; oversees national disease control programs.
activities: Advising Cabinet and health ministry on pandemic prevention, vaccination protocols, and drug policy
Overseeing national programs for tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases, and non-communicable diseases
Directing central government hospitals and the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO)

title: Chief Medical Officer (CMO) - District
description: Heads the district healthcare establishment; oversees community health centers (CHCs), maternal-child health programs, and disease containment.
activities: Supervising universal immunization drives, Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, and hospital bed infrastructure
Executing outbreaks investigation and containment measures under Integrated Disease Surveillance Program (IDSP)
Enforcing PC-PNDT Act, Clinical Establishments Act, and Food Safety regulations across the district

title: Medical Officer (Primary Health Centre - PHC)
description: Provides clinical outpatient/inpatient care at rural PHCs, conducts emergency deliveries, and supervises grassroots health workers (ANM/ASHA).
activities: Conducting clinical consultations, emergency trauma care, and institutional deliveries
Supervising village-level National Health Mission programs, immunization, and nutritional tracking
Managing PHC medicine stocks, cold chain equipment, and uploading records onto the ABDM portal

title: Drugs Inspector / Regulatory Officer
cadre_group: Central / State Drugs Standard Control Cadre
description: Inspects pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities, blood banks, and pharmacy retailers to prevent spurious, adulterated, or substandard drugs.
activities: Conducting GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) audits of active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) plants
Drawing statutory drug samples for analysis at government testing laboratories
Investigating complaints regarding spurious formulations and launching criminal prosecutions in Special Courts

title: Block Development Officer (BDO)
ministry_department: Department of Rural Development & Panchayati Raj
domain: Block Level Rural Administration & Scheme Convergence
description: Executive head of the Community Development Block; coordinates all rural development schemes, MGNREGA, PM Awas Yojana, and Panchayati Raj institutions.
activities: Sanctioning and monitoring execution of MGNREGA work projects and geotagged asset verification
Supervising rural housing (PMAY-G), water supply (Jal Jeevan Mission), and sanitation drives
Inspecting Gram Panchayats, approving developmental expenditure, and resolving public grievances

title: Panchayat Secretary / Gram Panchayat Development Officer
description: Executive secretary to the Gram Panchayat; executes Gram Sabha resolutions, maintains panchayat accounts, and issues certificates.
activities: Organizing Gram Sabha meetings, recording minutes, and drafting Gram Panchayat Development Plans (GPDP)
Maintaining Panchayat accounts on e-GramSwaraj and executing online vendor payments via PFMS
Issuing birth, death, and residency certificates, and maintaining family register records

title: Patwari / Lekhpal / Talathi
description: Grassroots revenue official in-charge of village land records; maintains Khasra/Khatauni, conducts crop loss girdawari, and performs ground demarcation.
activities: Updating computerized land records (RoR) and recording mutual succession/mutations
Conducting seasonal crop inspections (Girdawari) to assess agricultural yields and disaster damages
Performing land demarcation using Total Station / DGPS rovers and issuing caste/income certificates

title: Village Level Worker (VLW) / Gram Rozgar Sahayak (GRS)
description: Manages daily muster rolls for rural employment, allocates work to job card holders, and records measurement of physical rural infrastructure.
activities: Recording attendance of laborers at work sites using the National Mobile Monitoring System (NMMS) app
Assisting Technical Assistants in measuring dug wells, rural roads, and check-dams
Distributing job cards, updating passbooks, and facilitating social audit hearings

title: Municipal Commissioner (Municipal Corporation)
cadre_group: Indian Administrative Service / Senior Urban Cadre
description: Executive head of the city municipal corporation; manages urban planning, solid waste processing, water supply, and municipal property taxes.
activities: Executing city master plans, smart city infrastructure, and urban transport projects
Managing municipal revenue mobilization, property tax collections, and GIS mapping of buildings
Directing municipal health, solid waste management systems, and anti-encroachment operations

title: Executive Engineer (Public Health / Urban Waterworks)
description: Directs municipal water treatment plants, pressurized distribution networks, sewage treatment plants (STPs), and storm-water drainage systems.
activities: Managing large-scale Water Treatment Plants (WTP) and SCADA-based distribution grids
Executing AMRUT scheme sewer network expansions and industrial effluent monitoring
Responding to municipal water contamination alerts and overseeing pipe replacement tenders

domain: Central Public Health and Environmental Engineering (CPHEEO) Norms

title: Town and Country Planner
domain: Spatial Urban Planning & Master Plan Zoning
description: Formulates regional master plans, zoning regulations, transit-oriented development (TOD) corridors, and evaluates layout approvals.
activities: Formulating 20-year City Master Plans and Land Use Zoning Regulations on GIS frameworks
Scrutinizing high-density commercial layouts, industrial parks, and affordable housing blueprints
Evaluating environmental impact and traffic dispersal models for urban development corridors

domain: Urban and Regional Development Plans Formulation (URDPFI) Guidelines

title: Sanitary Inspector / Food Safety Officer (Urban)
domain: Urban Hygiene, Waste Enforcement & Food Safety
description: Inspects hotels, food joints, street vending zones, slaughterhouses, and enforces door-to-door waste segregation standards.
activities: Inspecting commercial food establishments and drawing statutory food samples under FSSAI rules
Monitoring municipal sanitation wards, public toilet maintenance, and legacy waste bio-mining
Issuing challans for open burning of garbage and single-use plastic violations

title: Member Secretary - State Pollution Control Board (SPCB)
ministry_department: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change / SPCB
description: Heads operational regulatory enforcement; issues Consents to Establish (CTE) and Consents to Operate (CTO) to industries, monitoring water/air effluents.
activities: Evaluating environmental compliance of red/orange category industries and issuing CTE/CTO sanctions
Monitoring Continuous Online Emission Monitoring Systems (OCEMS) across industrial clusters
Ordering closure or environmental damage compensations against non-compliant polluting units

title: Environmental Engineer / Scientist (CPCB / SPCB)
description: Conducts surprise industrial inspections, stack emission measurements, river water testing, and analyzes National Air Quality Index (AQI) networks.
activities: Conducting source-apportionment and stack emission sampling using isokinetic probes
Auditing Common Effluent Treatment Plants (CETPs) and municipal STPs for discharge limits
Managing Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Stations (CAAQMS) and publishing AQI reports

domain: CPCB Standard Methods for Water/Air Testing

title: Chief Engineer (CPWD / PWD)
ministry_department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / CPWD
description: Directs multi-crore government building construction, supreme court/secretariat maintenance, and green building standard deployments.
activities: Approving architectural, structural, and electro-mechanical designs for major government complexes
Managing EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) tenders and dispute resolution arbitration
Enforcing GRIHA green-rating standards and seismic safety in public structures

title: Assistant Executive Engineer (AEE - Civil / Electrical)
description: Heads a Sub-Division; supervises construction sites, verifies contractor measurements, checks material testing, and signs work bills.
activities: Supervising on-site RCC pouring, steel reinforcement testing, and structural safety execution
Recording detailed measurements in Electronic Measurement Books (e-MB) and verifying invoices
Enforcing worker occupational health, safety norms, and project schedules on site

domain: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) Construction Codes

title: District Education Officer (DEO)
description: Administers school education at the district level, ensuring RTE compliance, teacher rationalization, and implementation of the National Education Policy (NEP).
activities: Monitoring school infrastructure and learning outcomes using the UDISE+ and Vidyanjali portals
Executing the PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal) scheme across all district government schools
Managing teacher transfers, rationalization, and capacity building via the DIKSHA platform

title: Block Education Officer (BEO)
domain: Block Level School Monitoring & RTE Enforcement
description: Inspects primary and middle schools at the block level, ensuring attendance, teacher availability, and distribution of educational DBT benefits.
activities: Conducting physical inspections of school classrooms, sanitation, and mid-day meal hygiene
Tracking Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) for student uniforms and textbooks
Organizing block-level sports, science exhibitions, and teacher training workshops

title: Principal, Kendriya Vidyalaya (KV)
description: Heads a Central Government school; responsible for academic performance, CBSE curriculum execution, campus administration, and student welfare.
activities: Implementing CBSE curriculum and continuous pedagogical assessments
Administering school funds, infrastructure maintenance, and local management committee meetings
Evaluating teacher performance through the KVS Shaala Darpan portal

title: Post Graduate Teacher (PGT)
description: Teaches specialized subjects to senior secondary classes, conducts board practicals, and utilizes smart-classroom digital tools.
activities: Delivering subject-specific lectures utilizing ICT tools, smartboards, and AR/VR educational modules
Formulating question papers, grading board exams, and conducting laboratory practicals
Providing career counseling and psychological support to adolescent students

title: Director of Agriculture
description: Formulates state-level farming policies, directs PM-KISAN execution, promotes climate-resilient agriculture, and regulates seed/fertilizer quality.
activities: Supervising the implementation of PM-KISAN, PM Fasal Bima Yojana, and state farm subsidies
Directing agricultural extension networks and promoting the e-NAM (National Agriculture Market) portal
Enforcing the Seed Act and Fertilizer Control Order to prevent spurious inputs

title: District Agriculture Officer (DAO)
description: Monitors sowing trends, manages district fertilizer stocks, provides pest-control advisories, and conducts crop-cutting experiments.
activities: Allocating subsidized seeds/fertilizers to blocks and inspecting pesticide dealerships
Coordinating crop-cutting experiments (CCE) using the Agri-Insurance mobile app
Mobilizing farmers for organic farming and micro-irrigation schemes (PMKSY)

title: Agricultural Scientist / KVK Head
description: Heads a Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK); conducts frontline demonstrations of new crop varieties, and transfers lab technologies to farmers.
activities: Conducting on-farm trials for high-yielding, climate-resilient crop varieties
Organizing farmer training camps on precision agriculture, drone-spraying, and soil-health cards
Providing real-time agro-meteorological advisories through SMS/Kisan Portals

title: Director General of Civil Aviation (DGCA)
description: Statutory head of civil aviation safety; responsible for airline licensing, airworthiness certification, and enforcement of ICAO standards.
activities: Issuing and suspending Air Operator Certificates (AOC) and commercial pilot licenses
Directing safety audits of airlines, airports, and drone (UAV) operators via the eGCA portal
Formulating Civil Aviation Requirements (CARs) aligned with global ICAO conventions

title: Aviation Safety Inspector (Airworthiness / Flight Operations)
description: Inspects commercial aircraft, evaluates maintenance protocols, conducts ramp checks, and ensures pilot proficiency standards.
activities: Conducting surprise ramp inspections of domestic/international aircraft at airports
Evaluating simulator training centers and renewing commercial pilot type-ratings
Investigating minor aviation incidents and enforcing groundings for safety non-compliance

title: Air Traffic Controller (ATC)
cadre_group: Airports Authority of India (AAI - ATC Cadre)
description: Guides aircraft through controlled airspace; prevents collisions, issues takeoff/landing clearances, and manages radar scopes.
activities: Monitoring primary/secondary surveillance radar to maintain aircraft separation minimums
Issuing vectoring, altitude, and speed instructions to pilots via VHF radio telephony
Coordinating emergency landings and airspace diversions during severe weather/hijack scenarios

title: Defence Estates Officer (DEO)
description: Manages defense land banks, prevents encroachments, handles land acquisition for the Armed Forces, and manages cantonment civic affairs.
activities: Digitizing defense land records using GIS and the Raksha Bhoomi portal to prevent encroachment
Processing land acquisition compensation and hiring/requisition of properties for military use
Overseeing municipal administration, property taxation, and health in Cantonment Boards

title: General Manager, Ordnance Factory
ministry_department: Ministry of Defence (Department of Defence Production)
description: Heads a defense manufacturing facility (DPSU); oversees production of ammunition, vehicles, and troop equipment.
activities: Managing assembly line production of artillery, small arms, or armored vehicles
Ensuring strict metallurgical and ballistic quality control standards for troop safety
Executing defense procurement contracts, inventory management, and R&D technology transfers

title: Scientist 'F' / Project Director (DRDO)
description: Leads advanced defense research projects (missiles, radars, combat aircraft) from design phase to user trials with the Armed Forces.
activities: Directing conceptual design, aerodynamic modeling, and prototyping of indigenous weapon systems
Coordinating telemetry, telemetry integration, and live-fire user trials at test ranges
Facilitating Transfer of Technology (ToT) to private defense manufacturers (Make in India)

title: Outstanding Scientist / Mission Director (ISRO)
description: Commands the launch of satellite and interplanetary missions; holds ultimate go/no-go authority for liftoff sequences.
activities: Leading pre-launch reviews, payload integration, and cryogenic stage testing
Commanding the Mission Control Centre (MCC) during the final launch countdown and orbital insertion
Executing emergency abort protocols or orbital correction maneuvers

title: Satellite Payload Engineer / Scientist 'D'
description: Designs, fabricates, and tests satellite payloads (optical cameras, radar sensors, communication transponders) for space deployment.
activities: Designing multi-band communication transponders and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) modules
Conducting thermo-vacuum and acoustic vibration testing of space payloads
Monitoring telemetry data of payloads post-launch to calibrate in-orbit performance

title: Director / Deputy Director General (Telecom)
description: Regulates telecom operators, manages spectrum allocation, enforces security guidelines, and oversees BharatNet rural broadband rollout.
activities: Auditing Telecom Service Providers (TSPs) for EMF radiation compliance and spectrum usage
Enforcing Lawful Interception & Monitoring (LIM) and telecom cybersecurity directives
Overseeing the rollout of 5G infrastructure and Optical Fibre Cable (OFC) under BharatNet

title: Sub Divisional Engineer (SDE) - Telecom
description: Manages core telecom exchanges, optical fiber networks, and FTTH (Fiber to the Home) deployment at the sub-divisional level.
activities: Maintaining Base Transceiver Stations (BTS), mobile towers, and IP/MPLS core networks
Supervising fiber-splicing operations and resolving major broadband (FTTH) fault tickets
Executing enterprise lease line integrations and managing exchange power/cooling infrastructure

title: Chief General Manager (CGM) - RBI
cadre_group: Reserve Bank of India (Senior Management - Grade F)
description: Heads a regional or central RBI department; supervises scheduled commercial banks, enforces monetary policy directives, and manages currency.
activities: Directing statutory inspections of commercial banks, NBFCs, and fintech payment aggregators
Enforcing Basel III capital adequacy norms, NPA provisioning, and FEMA compliance
